subject: Suggestions for Handling Text in a ForestPlot

messages.author: 22feb3a6a7ab65f0
messages.subject: Suggestions for Handling Text in a ForestPlot
parts:
I was looking at the ForestPlot code posted in
http://www.r-bloggers.com/forest-plots-using-r-and-ggplot2/ (below)
and was wondering what was a good approach for handling additional
text to the "variable names" variable d$x? and having it formatted in
columns for example having "Previous injection 0.755
0.333-1.712". Adding tabs between the variables is one option (but
doesn't address all cases). Is there a way to add fixed column
locations?

credplot.gg <- function(d){
# d is a data frame with 4 columns
# d$x gives variable names
# d$y gives center point
# d$ylo gives lower limits
# d$yhi gives upper limits
require(ggplot2)
p <- ggplot(d, aes(x=x, y=y, ymin=ylo, ymax=yhi))+geom_pointrange()
+
coord_flip() + geom_hline(aes(x=0), lty=2)+
xlab('Variable')
return(p)
}
